messages.message: Thanks for calling the clinic. This is the virtual assistant. How can I help you today?

Hi, um, yeah. My name is Aaliyah Okafor. I'm a patient of Dr. Ramos. I was calling because I have a question about my sertraline. I've been feeling worse lately, and I was wondering if I can double my dose this week.

Thank you for telling me, Aaliyah. Questions about your medication dose need to be answered by a clinician, so I'm connecting you with a staff member now. If you start feeling unsafe or thoughts of hurting yourself come up, call or text 988 right away, or call 911 if you're in immediate danger.
